programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits an extraordinary beauty salon located in Lahore, Pakistan.His services are used by women who have suffered acid burns in the past.Dousing and arson attacks affect up to several thousand women every year.A bottle of acid does not cost even a zloty, the substance is easily available, and the attack lasts a few seconds.The traveler talks to Musarrat Misbah, who has already helped over five hundred injured women.It provides victims with proper medical care, reconstructive surgery, psychological care and employment.He gives them jobs in his salon.Viewers will see what the life of the so-calledfaceless women.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska goes to Pakistan, where she meets members of the Kalash tribe.They are the only non-Muslim community in this country, the last descendants of the inhabitants of ancient Kafiristan, who inhabit the lands located on the border of today's Pakistan and Afghanistan.Only about four thousand of them survived.Kalaska women choose their own husbands, and when they do not treat them well or the relationship does not work out, they leave to look for a new partner.Free relationships are also allowed among the Kalash, which are prohibited in any other Pakistani community.

programme.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Country music is a key part of American culture.Thanks to contemporary artists such as Taylor Swift and Beyonce, the genre is attracting new generations of listeners.During his visit to Nashville, Marcin Prokop tries to understand what makes country more than just music.He meets with the artists' agent, visits an independent music studio where he observes a recording session, and talks to the curator of the legendary Ryman Auditorium.He also discovers a unique Polish exhibit in a private automotive museum.During his journey, he meets Tomek Wosiak, an emigrant from Gdynia, a renowned chef and manager of popular restaurants in the USA, who cooperates with the biggest stars.

programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches La Paz.Bolivian women have played a primarily reproductive role for centuries.They are caregivers in their families, dependent on men in every aspect of life.If they do not want to comply, they may be beaten.It is in Bolivia that the rate of violence against women remains the highest in all of South America.Meanwhile, some of them decided to fight stereotypes and exchange chef's aprons for crayfish and then conquer the peaks.Martyna Wojciechowska meets such people.They belong to the cholit climbing team from La Paz, led by its founder, Alicia.In this episode, the traveler will also visit Carmen Rojas, the heroine of the first season of the program.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: This time the destination is Belgium, Brussels - the very heart of the European Union.Martyna Wojciechowska manages, among others,to one of the capital's districts, Molenbeek, where he talks to the mothers of jihadists.It turns out that more than five thousand people left the Old Continent, and more than five hundred people left Belgium itself.They all left to fight on the side of the so-called Islamic State.We are talking about young people, women and children.The traveler tries to find out why they decided to join a terrorist organization.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: For Martyna Wojciechowska, the most important value is freedom.During her travels in the ninth season of the program, she decided to show what she means to others - her characters.The Malaysian fish people have cut themselves off from civilization.The Kazakh girl breaks all stereotypes and excels in activities reserved only for men.Pakistani Masarrat Misbah, thanks to her courage, is changing the world, restoring freedom to others.Kalashka Iran Bibi lives according to the centuries-old tradition of his ancestors despite external pressures.In Japan, Martyna Wojciechowska found people free from any prejudices.However, sometimes honest conversations bring further questions - about the price that Bolivian cholitas pay for their independence;about whether jihadist mothers could limit the freedom of their children, and whether Mennonites are making the right choice by consciously deciding on a life limited by rigid rules.
